name: korean_radio_alarm
description: Korean radio music service with a configurable weekly alarm for Volumio 4 Bookworm.
author: rightway-p

volumio_info.details: Scheduled Korean radio alarm plugin for Volumio 4 (Bookworm).
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.4: add per-slot alarm action (play/stop); 0.1.3: fix dynamic alarm-slot migration, id persistence, and UI section rendering; 0.1.2: resolve KBS stream URLs through KBS play API and cache resolver results in-memory; 0.1.1: review-prep/default alarm-slot config and submission readiness updates; 0.1.0: initial release.
